decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed letting agency would not result in a concentration of A2 uses in the locality and would not affect the vitality and viability of the shopping parade.  It would not result in the loss of an essential local shop and adequate parking would be provided.  The developemnt would comply with Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.B. 1.1 (New Development), S.2.2. (Non retail uses in other shopping areas) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No.GIFTO/144/B/REVISED and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - The proposed new shopfront shall have a level threshold flush with the adjoining pavement  and the doorway shall have a minimum clear width with the door open of 900 mm and the door shall be framed and have a 400 mm high kicking plate at its base.

Condition : 6 - The A2 use shall not commence until details of a shop window display or other frontage complementary to the character of the shopping centre have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and be permanently retained
description: Installation of roller shutter and change of use from A1 to A2 (Property Letting)
